title: The paperfuge
body: A paperfuge is a low-cost, hand-powered device made from a cardboard disc, string and handles. A small tube holding a drop of blood is taped to the disc. When the strings are pulled, the disc spins at a very high speed. After a few minutes of spinning, the blood in the tube is no longer uniform: a dark red layer collects at the end of the tube farthest from the centre of the disc, and a pale yellow liquid layer remains at the end nearer the centre. Health workers in remote areas without electricity use such devices to examine blood samples and help detect diseases such as malaria and anaemia.
